title: Google Sheets Protected Range Is NOT a Security Lock #Shorts
description: A visual, original fictional learning example from FlowMinute Lab. A protected Google Sheets range can limit editing, but Google warns that protection is not a security measure. Learn the safe verification step using the official product guidance below. Original diagrams and synthetic English narration; not a real account or software screen capture. Official source: https://support.google.com/docs/answer/1218656 #FlowMinuteLab #TechTips

scenes.title: PROTECTED IS NOT SECRET
scenes.narration: A protected Google Sheets range can limit editing, but Google warns that protection is not a security measure.

scenes.title: WHO CAN EDIT
scenes.narration: In Data, Protect sheets and ranges, you can choose who is allowed to edit a particular area.

scenes.title: WARNING OR RESTRICT
scenes.narration: A warning is not an editing block. Choose Restrict who can edit if you need an actual editing limit.

scenes.title: THE COPY CATCH
scenes.narration: Google notes that people with access may still be able to copy or export protected spreadsheet content.

scenes.title: SHARE CAREFULLY
scenes.narration: Use protection to prevent accidental edits, not to hide secrets. Share sensitive sheets only with people you trust.
